summary: Iter 30 — FEATURED ranking + MERCHANT AD SPACE fully verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 8/8 PASS (featured-first sort, featured+subscription_tier fields on /api/restaurants, AD_PACKAGES TT$300/1000/1500, /api/ads/active sample 'Ad Spice Kitchen' present, click increment, merchant ad CRUD with pause-excludes-from-active, invalid pkg 400, unauth 401/403). Frontend: /restaurants renders 108 cards with 5 'Featured' gold badges grouped at the top (newly-created premium merchant appears in featured group), card click navigates to /restaurant/<id>. Landing 'Sponsored Partners' section renders with the sample ad card. /vendor-dashboard 'Advertise' button (vendor-ads-btn) navigates to /merchant/ads; full create→list→toggle (Pause/Resume)→delete flow works; publish button correctly updates to 'Publish & Pay TT$300' after pkg select; success toast 'Ad published — Your ad is live for 7 days!' shown. No critical or minor bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py L3334-3470 ad endpoints are correctly scoped to vendor_id via _resolve_vendor_for_user. Paused ads correctly filtered from /api/ads/active by both Mongo query (status:'active') and _ad_is_live() expiry check. Status code for unauthenticated POST /api/merchant/ads is 401/403 (FastAPI default). All endpoints exclude _id (find with projection {'_id':0}).

Backend get_restaurants (L1255) sorts by (0 if featured else 1, -rating) — featured-first ranking is stable and correct. featured + subscription_tier are persisted on the restaurant doc by /api/merchant/subscription/select (L3317).

Frontend SponsoredAds.js is correctly eager-imported in App.js and renders only when active homepage ads exist (graceful empty-state hide). data-testid='sponsored-ads-section' + 'sponsored-ad-<id>' present and functional.

MerchantAds.js form correctly uses Radix Select (data-testid='ad-package-select'). Publish button text dynamically reflects the selected package price (verified TT$300 for home_7). Image upload is hidden file input triggered by data-testid='ad-image-upload' button — works.

MINOR: VendorDashboard issues 401 on /orders & /stats for a freshly-promoted merchant whose user_type is still 'customer' (admin approval pending). This is pre-existing behavior (see test_credentials.md) and unrelated to iter30 scope. The 'Advertise' button and /merchant/ads flow are unaffected — they resolve by restaurant ownership.

Sample 'Ad Spice Kitchen' ad has internal cta_url ('/restaurant/<id>'), so card click navigates in-app rather than opening a new tab. This matches code default in server.py L3424 (cta_url defaults to /restaurant/<vendor_id>).
